title: Vacuum lifting device for handling sheet material

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.quote: The device is powered by readily available electrical 110 or 220 volt power supplies and does not depend on complex, expensive, separate, remotely located vacuum pumps.
features.note: The reference describes a self-contained device that does not depend on remotely located vacuum pumps, but it is powered by external electrical supplies (110 or 220 volt) and does not mention integrated battery power or being handheld.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.quote: vacuum pad means, including a sealing gasket, secured at its lower end.
features.note: The reference explicitly mentions a 'sealing gasket' as part of the vacuum pad means.
features.refuted: The quote mentions a 'sealing gasket' but does not specify it as a 'flexible sealing lip' or that it 'bounds a sealed region against a workpiece.'

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.quote: A vacuum pump is mounted within the housing.
features.note: The abstract states that a vacuum pump is mounted within the housing, which serves as a protective housing for the device.
features.refuted: The quote mentions 'A vacuum pump is mounted within the housing' but does not specify it as an 'electric vacuum pump' or that it 'draws air from a sealed region.'

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.quote: Controls, including a manually actuatable on/off electric switch for the pump motor and a manually actuatable open/closed vacuum release valve, as well as a vacuum gauge, are mounted on the cover member
features.note: The reference mentions a 'vacuum gauge' which monitors the vacuum level.
features.refuted: The quote mentions a 'vacuum gauge' which monitors vacuum, but does not specify it as a 'pressure sensor' or that it monitors the 'vacuum level in the sealed region.' It also mentions other controls not relevant to the assertion.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.note: The reference mentions a vacuum gauge to indicate when a desired low pressure exists, but it does not describe any warning indicator or threshold related to vacuum falling above a release level.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: The reference does not disclose any warning threshold, nor how it would be defined.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: The reference does not disclose any warning indicator or its behavior.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: The reference states the device is powered by 110 or 220 volt power supplies, not an integrated rechargeable battery.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.quote: Controls, including a manually actuatable on/off electric switch for the pump motor and a manually actuatable open/closed vacuum release valve, as well as a vacuum gauge, are mounted on the cover member so as to be accessible to the person
features.note: The reference mentions a vacuum gauge mounted on the cover member for accessibility, which could be considered a type of indicator. However, it does not describe a 'warning indicator' specifically, nor does it explicitly state its visibility during lifting operations as a design feature.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.quote: The present invention provides an improved, self-contained, compact, relatively small vacuum lifting device which is adapted to be suspended from the loadline of an overhead crane
features.note: The device is described as self-contained, compact, and relatively small, with all components carried by the rigid body. However, it is designed to be suspended from a crane, not necessarily for single-hand portable operation, and it requires an external electrical cable for power.

overall.why: The reference describes a self-contained vacuum lifting device with a vacuum pump, sealing gasket, and vacuum gauge, which are core elements of the subject invention. However, it lacks key features such as integrated battery power, a handheld design, and specific warning indicators related to vacuum
